title: Composition of canonical derived constant units
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category B with functorial flat resolutions, a constant coefficient object a, and composable scheme morphisms e:X→Y and p:Y→Z, the canonical derived constant unit for p followed by Rp_* of the canonical unit for e and rightDerivedLowerStarComp equals the canonical derived constant unit for e≫p. This identity uses the canonical upperStarConstantSheafIso comparisons [def-asd-derived-single-unit, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Specializing at ModuleCat A gives the composition equation for the unchanged supportedDerivedUnit [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. The existing ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_hom equation [lem-amb-ordinary-finite-unit-pullback-hom] identifies that supported unit with the unit of the recorded finite adjunction [def-sp-ordinary-finite-coefficient-records] followed by direct image of the published constant comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem constantDerivedUnit_comp (B : Type u') [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B]
    [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ⟶ Y) (p : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : B) :
    let C₀ := (constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology B).obj a
    let D₀ := (constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B).obj a
    let E₀ := (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B).obj a
    Adjunction.derivedSingleUnit (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B p) C₀ D₀
        ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso B p).hom.app a) ≫
      (lowerStar B p).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        (Adjunction.derivedSingleUnit (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B e) D₀ E₀
          ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso B e).hom.app a)) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarComp B e p).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj E₀) =
    Adjunction.derivedSingleUnit (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B (e ≫ p)) C₀ E₀
      ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso B (e ≫ p)).hom.app a)
